headline: Roberto De Zerbi: I 'kissed' Rodrigo Bentancur after red card, the 'character' that Spurs need
description: Tottenham Hotspur boss Roberto De Zerbi has revealed that he "kissed" Rodrigo Bentancur after his red card against Manchester United on Saturday, saying that his Spurs team need this type of "reaction."

headline: Michael Carrick 'hurt' by boos as Man United fall to worst start in 40 years
description: Michael Carrick said the boos at Old Trafford "hurt" after the 1-1 draw with Tottenham condemned Manchester United to their worst start to a season for 40 years.

headline: Man United should've beaten Spurs. Not doing so shows how much trouble Carrick & Co. are in
description: Up a goal and a man after 90 minutes, Man United could only draw 1-1 vs. Spurs, a result that leaves the Red Devils off to their worst start since 1986.

headline: Unai Emery 'sad' after Aston Villa draw with Brentford
description: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery said he was "sad" after his side drew 2-2 with Brentford at Villa Park.
